principles: Erst den realen Erfolgs-/Interaktionspunkt verifizieren, dann Event benennen und Tagging erzeugen.
Production Reference ist Evidenz fuer ein funktionierendes Muster, keine Soll-Konfiguration fuer andere Kunden.
Kunden-IDs, Domains, Labels, Consent-Entscheidungen, Waehrungen, CSS/Pfade und Business-Events nie uebernehmen.
Google Ads bei serverseitiger Conversion-Messung nicht parallel als gleichartige Browser-Conversion doppeln.
Meta Browser + CAPI nur mit identischem event_name und stabil gleicher event_id zur Deduplizierung.
Marketing-Consent nie aus dem Referenzsetup erben; pro Kunde/CMP/Region verifizieren.

purchase.source: verified purchase-success event/dataLayer; source event name is site-specific
web: route through verified sGTM transport when architecture=server
server: Google Ads conversion tag may read ecommerce fields automatically
Meta CAPI Purchase only when requested/consented

start_trial.source: verified trial activation/success, not a guessed CTA click
start_trial.server_destinations: business decision; do not automatically create Ads/Meta conversions
start_trial.note: Production reference used a differently cased event. New plans prefer canonical lowercase GA4 naming when semantics match.

lead_or_booking.meta_event: Choose standard event from real semantics (e.g. Lead or Schedule); do not infer from button text alone.
lead_or_booking.server_destinations: only destinations explicitly selected in plan

newsletter_signup.note: Do not misuse GA4 sign_up unless the action really creates/registers a user account.

scroll_50.source: GTM scroll trigger or dataLayer, if this measurement is actually useful

custom_completion.source: verified completion callback/dataLayer preferred over brittle CSS/text click
custom_completion.server_destinations: only if business value and ad-platform mapping are explicitly defined
